## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible issue and final change.

## Verification

List commands/results, meaningful regression scenarios, and skipped/environment-dependent checks. Include mobile widths for UI changes. Do not attach secrets or active links.

## Compatibility, security, and data safety

Describe authorization/session/MFA impact, dependency changes, migration preconditions, and rollout/rollback needs. State "none" when there is no such impact.

## Review

- [ ] Synthetic data only; source/staged secrets scan reviewed
- [ ] Behavior and negative-path tests cover the change
- [ ] Documentation/ADR updated where relevant
- [ ] Human review required before merge; production/publication approval is separate
